# THEME (CANDIDATE 1): Nuclear Renaissance — need vs. feasibility, decided 2026–2028

*Status: Stage 0 draft (experiment input). Source inspiration: Agents_Economics
hypothesis `nuclear-need-vs-feasibility`. Same caveats as the starter theme:
facts must be re-derived with provenance in Stage 1; priors are drafts; no
price-action reasoning is carried into the basket approach.*

- **strategy_tag:** `nuclear-renaissance`
- **Contamination assessment:** Strongly forward-unresolved — the source note's
  framing is exactly right for this experiment: "the bull case and the bear case
  are both obviously true." Restart execution and SMR order conversion resolve
  inside the evaluation window, after the model's knowledge horizon.
- **Cluster note:** shares the "AI power demand" upstream link with the starter
  theme. If both are ever active, cluster risk budgeting treats them as one
  cluster — flagged now so sizing cannot silently double the bet.

## 1. Causal chain

Datacenter power demand growth → scarcity of firm, carbon-free, 24/7 power →
hyperscalers willing to pay premiums, sign 20-year offtakes, and finance
construction risk → restart economics become provable (existing plants) and SMR
orders can reach financial close → if execution is demonstrated in the 2026–2028
window: existing-fleet operators re-rate on PPA premiums, fuel-cycle volume
grows with Russian-supply substitution, and services/component demand follows.
The bet is on the referee (execution evidence in-window), not on either team's
narrative.

## 2. Forecasts (draft — 7 resolvable statements)

| # | Statement | Prior | Horizon | Resolution criterion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Palisades achieves sustained commercial operation (grid-connected generation reported by the operator/NRC) | 0.70 | 2027-06-30 | Operator filing / NRC status showing commercial operation before horizon |
| 2 | Crane (TMI-1) achieves sustained commercial operation | 0.55 | 2028-06-30 | Same criterion |
| 3 | ≥1 US SMR project reaches financial close with construction start (not MOU, not application) | 0.35 | 2028-06-30 | Public financing documents + verified construction commencement |
| 4 | ≥2 additional hyperscaler-backed nuclear PPAs ≥500MW aggregate are signed (firm contracts, disclosed in filings/press releases) | 0.60 | 2027-12-31 | Counted disclosed firm PPAs after 2026-07-17 |
| 5 | Uranium term price (UxC/Cameco-reported long-term indicator) is above its 2026-06-30 level at horizon | 0.60 | 2027-12-31 | Published long-term price indicator |
| 6 | No US state enacts legislation blocking nuclear restarts/SMR deployment | 0.80 | 2028-06-30 | State legislative records; resolves FALSE if any such statute is enacted |
| 7 | A flagship US restart or SMR project is publicly cancelled or announces a ≥2x budget overrun | 0.25 | 2028-06-30 | Operator/sponsor public disclosure |

Forecast 7 scores the bear case directly; it doubles as the CAUSAL_BREAK tripwire.

## 3. Exposure basket — approach

Candidate pool: S&P 500 members with measurable nuclear exposure. Note the
universe constraint bites here — much of the speculative SMR complex is not in
the S&P 500, which naturally tilts the basket toward existing-fleet operators,
fuel/services, and power infrastructure. Ranking criteria (measured only):
- % of generation capacity / MWh from nuclear (utility filings, EIA)
- Disclosed nuclear PPA revenue or contracted-offtake share
- Segment revenue/profit from nuclear fuel, components, or services (10-K segments)
- Backlog attributable to nuclear programs
- Management emphasis on restarts/SMR/uplift in transcripts (counted, cited)

Barred: price history, momentum, price targets. Source-note tickers not carried.

## 4. Valuation check — plan

Existing-fleet operators may already price scarcity premiums. Stage 1 computes
each candidate's EV/EBITDA and P/E percentile vs. own history and utility peers,
plus (deterministic, where data allows) an implied premium of contracted-PPA
names over non-contracted regulated peers. The thesis is only investable if the
premium is not already at the top of its historical range, per config threshold.

## 5. Exit criteria

- **PRICE_STOP:** adverse move beyond config stop; or idiosyncratic single-name
  event unrelated to the chain (plant outage at one utility, unrelated segment
  miss). Trade closes; thesis and forecasts unaffected.
- **CAUSAL_BREAK:** forecast 7's event occurs (flagship cancellation or ≥2x
  blowout); OR a significant civil-nuclear safety incident (INES ≥ 5) anywhere;
  OR both named restarts miss their announced operation dates by >12 months.
  Basket liquidates; thesis invalidated; forecasts resolve per criteria.
- **VALUATION_EXIT:** milestones confirming but basket valuation percentile
  above config ceiling — thesis right, priced in; close at profit, keep scoring.
- **TIME_STOP:** 2028-06-30.

## 6. Do-nothing case (seed for the Independent Reviewer)

The execution proof points the thesis depends on (restart completion, SMR
financial close) have a long history of slipping; the S&P 500-eligible names are
mostly the least-leveraged way to own the outcome, so even a correct thesis may
produce modest returns in this universe while the real convexity sits outside
it. If the investable expression is weak, "track the milestones, take no
position" is the correct output.
